items.title: Russell holds off Verstappen by 0.196s to win in Baku
items.summary: George Russell converted pole into victory in the 51-lap Azerbaijan Grand Prix, with Max Verstappen second and Isack Hadjar third. Kimi Antonelli recovered from 16th on the grid to finish fifth. The official standings now list Antonelli on 302 points and Russell on 236.
items.why_it_matters: Russell's win narrows the championship gap, while Hadjar took a podium on his return to racing. The standings figures are current post-race totals, not a pre-weekend snapshot.

items.title: Colapinto apologises after collision with Alpine team-mate Gasly
items.summary: Franco Colapinto apologised after his Turn 1 collision with Pierre Gasly during the race restart. FIA Document 66 later imposed a 10-second time penalty, converted to five grid places at the next race in which he participates.
items.why_it_matters: The penalty affects Colapinto's next eligible race, not Azerbaijan's classification. Keep his apology distinct from the stewards' decision.
